            f.fst_ord_prc_amt,
            f.fst_ord_bsy_typ,
            f.fst_fal_ord_stg_num,
            f.fst_fal_ord_prc_amt,
            f.fst_fal_ord_crt_tim_hor,
            f.fst_fal_ord_bsy_typ,
            f.ds,
            f.ddf_mdl_max_suc_stg_num_ord_crt_dte,
            f.ddf_mdl_max_suc_prc_amt_ord_crt_dte,
            f.ddf_mdl_lst_ord_crt_dte,
            f.ddf_mdl_fst_ord_crt_dte,
            f.ddf_mdl_cur_ord_crt_dte,
            f.ddf_fst_lst_ord_crt_dte,
            f.ddf_fst_cur_ord_crt_dte,
            f.ddf_fst_adt_fst_ord_crt_dte_mnt,
            f.ddf_fst_adt_fst_ord_crt_dte,
            f.ddf_ato_fst_ord_crt_dte,

            f.cur_ord_rn,

            f.bsy_typ_suc_cnt_30_day,
            f.bsy_typ_suc_cnt_180_day,
            f.avg_ddf_fst_lst_ord_crt_dte,
            row_number() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        *
                    FROM
                        dwa_risk.dwa_risk_dz_model_final_7fst_9all_10cur_11lst_orders_info_df
                    WHERE
                        to_date(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd')) >= ${min_ds}
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field} = f.uid
        AND
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) = 0
    ) o  WHERE rn=1;
